Proof

↗ lem:curve-shrinking-first-variation ↗ lem:spacetime-christoffel \sketch Differentiate $k^2=|H|^2$ in the $\widehat H$ direction, commute $\widehat H$ past $S$, and use Equations (5)–(6). The second $S$-derivative splits as

egin{equation} 2\langle abla _S abla _S\widehat H,H angle =2\langle abla _S abla _S\partial _t,H angle +2\langle abla _S abla _SH,H angle . \end{equation}

The first term supplies $-2( abla ^g_S\Ric _g)(S,H)-2\Ric _g(H,H)$; the second supplies $(k^2)''-2|( abla _SH)^\perp |^2-2k^4$. Substituting $[\widehat H,S]=(k^2+\Ric _g(S,S))S$ gives the displayed formula.
